items.title: Milford Dolliole Interview, 1965-05-22
items.q: Of course, Louis Armstrong always talks about Black Benny, the drummer uptown around Perdido Street and all that played.

ctx.x: Yeah, I heard him in several band dances. He plays pretty good. He was a pretty good drummer. Yeah.
Of course, Louis Armstrong always talks about Black Benny, the drummer uptown around Perdido Street and all that played. Yeah, I remember him too. You got to hear him. I remember him.
